name: Latin pop (reggaeton-pop)
summary: Mid-tempo dembow pop: minor keys, 4-chord loops, nylon guitar and plucks over an 808 tresillo bass.
keys: minor (most): A, B, C#, F# minor

harmony.notes: One loop for the whole song is idiomatic; contrast comes from arrangement, not new chords. The bridge may switch to a iv- or VI-led loop.

bass.register: 808 sub, roots C1-B1; vary=true adds core/bass_tresillo_808_variation

keys.sound: warm pad or soft piano, low in the mix

sounds.kit: drum_machine (Boomy 808) or drum_sampler; shaker, guiro and congas need samples
sounds.guitar: poly_synth: Pluck Lead or a nylon guitar plugin

mix.notes: Kick and 808 own the lows (sidechain the 808 lightly to the kick); guitar panned slightly; keep 1-4 kHz for the vocal; short plate reverb.

do: Drop the kick in the last bar of the pre-chorus
Thin out the verses (half the roles)
Add a fill or riser into every chorus
Keep the dembow; vary hats and perc instead
dont: Same drum pattern in every section
